feat: add Supplier Risk Monitor screen for QSC demo

New SupplierRiskMonitor component (single-file, self-contained):
- Supplier list: 4 cards (Winn/Corevo/Amphenol/TTM) with risk score,
  country, tier, active risk badges, and Revenue at Risk placeholder
- Detail panel: score ring, overall risk bar with 0-40-70 scale,
  Revenue at Risk (prominent, amber-bordered, with note:
  "Revenue impact calculation requires BOM + COGS data from customer.
  Placeholder shown for MVP1."), 2x2 dimension breakdown grid,
  supplier profile fields, data integration pending callout
- Color coding: red ≥70 CRITICAL, amber 40-70 MODERATE, green <40 LOW
- MVP1/QSC demo badge in sub-header with MRO show date
- Navigate via tab strip: RADAR Dashboard | Supplier Risk Monitor (NEW)

commit.message:
feat: build RADAR supply chain risk dashboard

Full demo-quality single-page dashboard with:
- Header bar: RADAR logo, live clock, Signal Brief badge, A&D sector tag
- Left panel: Seven Clocks — 7 stacked alert cards with urgency badges,
  risk lens tags, countdown timers, and RADAR Signal sections
- Centre panel: Leaflet.js dark-themed global risk map with 7 geo-markers
  colour-coded by urgency (CRITICAL/ELEVATED/MONITOR), popup details,
  and impact-bucket counters (Delivery / Compliance / Cost)
- Right panel: Decision Window timeline (30-day bar per critical clock),
  Affected Supply Chain Layers bar chart (Recharts), and interactive
  Operator Actions checklist with progress tracker
- Dark theme: #0F1117 bg, #1A1D2E cards, #1E3A5F accent navy
- GitHub Actions workflow for GitHub Pages deployment
